title: The polymorphic discriminator "QuantumDelta" is registered nowhere
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: `"args":[["Stall",{"reason":"SUSPENDED"}]]` rewritten to `"args":[["QuantumDelta",{}]]`, a discriminator no `SerializersModule` registration knows. normative ([WIR1-I08]): observed kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException "Serializer for subclass 'QuantumDelta' is not found in the polymorphic scope of 'Any'." — decodeFrame throws; the value is neither dropped nor null-substituted, so an invocation with args == [null] or args == [] would be a driver failure, not this vector's outcome. Dead-letter accounting on the receiving side is covered by wire/src/test/kotlin/civictech/wire/WsIngressDecodeFailureTest.kt, not retested here.
